paragraphs.en: There's no business like show business — but in Los Angeles, it feels like there's no business at all.
paragraphs.zh: 没有哪个行业能像演艺业一样——但在洛杉矶，人们却感觉根本没什么生意可做。

paragraphs.en: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession." This is a reaction to Hollywood's decline, which is reaching a critical point for the industry and Southern California.
paragraphs.zh: 如果这听起来有些夸张，不妨看看这件事：代表约3000名电影从业人员的工会——艺术指导协会，已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发表声明解释说：‘凭良心讲，我们无法鼓励你们投身我们的职业。’这是对好莱坞衰退的回应，而这种衰退对电影行业和南加利福尼亚州而言，正达到一个危急关头。

paragraphs.en: Production has been slipping away from Hollywood since the 1950s, but the effects have never been more apparent than at present. Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust. Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
paragraphs.zh: 自20世纪50年代以来，影视制作就一直在从好莱坞流向别处，但其影响从未像现在这样明显。美国其他地区、加拿大和欧洲不断加大优惠力度，以吸引电视剧和电影制作，使加利福尼亚州远远落后。佐治亚州对电影和电视制作成本提供最高30%的可转让税收抵免；如果项目包含佐治亚州的宣传标识，还会在基础税收抵免之上额外增加10%。

paragraphs.en: Even as California lost a huge volume of production to other locations, there was still plenty of film production taking place in Los Angeles before this year. We were kept afloat by "peak TV", the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管加利福尼亚州有大量影视制作转移到了其他地方，但在今年之前，洛杉矶仍然有大量电影制作活动。让我们维持运转的是‘电视剧巅峰期’：流媒体服务爆发式增长，需要海量内容来满足需求。

paragraphs.en: But 2022 was the peak of peak TV. Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year. As the streamers' emphasis changed from subscriber growth to profitability, prices for the services went up and the number of new shows went down to 481 released in 2023, with the number expected to dip into the 300s within a few years.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，2022年已是电视剧巅峰期的顶点。那时，奈飞、亚马逊和苹果电视等平台不惜亏损数十亿美元来制作内容，以吸引新订户，结果当年推出了633部有剧本的剧集。随着流媒体平台将重心从用户增长转向盈利，服务价格上涨，新剧数量下降，2023年推出的剧集减少到481部，而且预计几年内会降至300多部。

paragraphs.en: If productions in Southern California dip below a critical level for too long, the industry's essential talent will drift away along with enormous sums of revenue. Persuading studios to film here would become much more challenging if we couldn't offer a deep bench of local film workers, on-screen talent and local businesses that support the entertainment industry.
paragraphs.zh: 如果南加利福尼亚州的影视制作活动长期低于某一临界水平，这个行业不可或缺的人才就会逐渐流失，巨额收入也将随之消失。如果我们无法提供充足的本地影视工作人员、出镜演艺人才以及为娱乐行业提供支持的本地企业，那么说服制片公司来这里拍摄就会变得困难得多。

paragraphs.en: That's why the California Film Commission and its Los Angeles counterpart, Film LA, now should act, before it's too late. These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles. Let's go on with the show…and make sure the show doesn't go on without us.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，加利福尼亚电影委员会及其在洛杉矶的对应机构Film LA，现在就应该采取行动，以免为时已晚。这些机构和其他政府部门应大幅提高优惠力度，留住我们现有的影视项目，并吸引新的制作项目来到洛杉矶。让演出继续下去吧……而且要确保演出继续时，我们仍在其中。
